name: How long does it take to repair rot damage around windows?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair rot damage around windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration depends on the severity of the rot. Minor repairs, such as scraping out soft wood and applying epoxy, might take a few hours to a day. More extensive repairs involving wood replacement or a full window installation can take one to several days per window, not including drying or curing times for sealants and paints. Multiple windows will naturally extend the project timeline.
